description: Defines the interface and implementation of a File class supporting asynchronous and synchronous IO operations within the disk cache component of Chromium, including callback handling and file management.

classes.name: FileIOCallback
classes.description: Interface for callback notification upon asynchronous file IO completion.

classes.name: File
classes.description: A wrapper class for file operations supporting both synchronous and asynchronous IO, with reference counting and internal state management.

methods.name: explicit File(bool mixed_mode)
methods.description: Constructor that sets whether the file operates in mixed (synchronous/asynchronous) mode.

methods.name: explicit File(base::File file)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the File object with an existing base::File.

methods.name: Init(const base::FilePath& name)
methods.description: Initializes the file object with a given file path.

methods.name: IsValid()
methods.description: Checks if the file was successfully opened.

methods.name: Read(void* buffer, size_t buffer_len, size_t offset)
methods.description: Performs synchronous read from the file.

methods.name: Write(const void* buffer, size_t buffer_len, size_t offset)
methods.description: Performs synchronous write to the file.

methods.name: Read(void* buffer, size_t buffer_len, size_t offset, FileIOCallback* callback, bool* completed)
methods.description: Performs asynchronous read with callback notification.

methods.name: Write(const void* buffer, size_t buffer_len, size_t offset, FileIOCallback* callback, bool* completed)
methods.description: Performs asynchronous write with callback notification.

methods.name: SetLength(size_t length)
methods.description: Sets the length of the file, truncating or extending as needed.

methods.name: GetLength()
methods.description: Returns the current length of the file.

methods.name: WaitForPendingIOForTesting(int* num_pending_io)
methods.description: Blocks until specified number of IO operations complete, for testing.

methods.name: DropPendingIO()
methods.description: Drops current pending IO operations without waiting.
